scope: unrouted composition of two exact physically bound PEX macros

actual_consumer_load_audit.note: PEX net audit excludes intrinsic MOS gate capacitance; values are routing and extracted explicit parasitics

schematic_local_interface_buffer.implementation: two polarity-preserving inverter stages per SENSE, BOOST, CLK, and CLKB phase; first-stage W=8 um with four PMOS and four NMOS fingers, final-stage W=8 um with sixteen PMOS and sixteen NMOS fingers

assertion_duration_screen.scope: programmable schematic event/interface candidate into exact lane PEX
assertion_duration_screen.localization: a full-cycle replica consumes the reset/high interval; zero delay passes TT but reaches only 1.401--1.406 V SENSE high at slow/hot, while one delay loses slow/hot SENSE entirely
assertion_duration_screen.decision: reject full-cycle delayed-replica stretching before layout; synthesize an edge-selective release path

edge_selective_release_screen.scope: direct SENSE assertion plus delayed conditional pull-down into exact lane PEX
edge_selective_release_screen.contract: each final 800-ps UI must contain 150--650 ps at both the <=250-mV and >=VDD-250-mV SENSE rails
edge_selective_release_screen.decision: reject before layout: every candidate passes TT and preserves rails/front-end/capture, but every slow/hot case violates the minimum high-rail reset duration

independent_start_end_sr.architecture: non-overlapping START/END-derived SETB and RESETB drive a static cross-coupled NAND state; only restored QB crosses to the SENSE taper
independent_start_end_sr.localization: With timing-lane placement and set_mult=8, RESETB remains valid and slow/hot SETB improves to 0.342/0.582 V, but QB reaches only 2.185/1.553 V high and SENSE remains low. Added SET capacitance also leaves TT without a complete valid-low interval.
independent_start_end_sr.decision: reject routed narrow-SET transport after the bounded placement-plus-strength experiment; retain as fully physical negative evidence and replace SETB with local latch write devices controlled only by full-duty states

localization.schematic_buffer_tt: all event-source and lane-side interface rails pass
localization.ss_hot_other_buffered_interfaces: BOOST, CLK, and CLKB pass rail screens on both phases
localization.ss_hot_failure: schematic buffer: lane-side SENSE discharge only; event source, other buffered rails, front end, capture polarity, and supply-current screen pass
localization.physical_v4_failure: TT narrowly misses the 250-mV rail screen; slow/hot pulse reaches the event source but is not restored through the two-stage physical buffer

decision: independent set/reset semantics close the limiting schematic composition, but both bounded physical remedies prove that transporting a narrow SETB event is not robust enough
next_boundary: integrate START/END-controlled write devices directly into a compact static latch so only full-duty states enter the cell and no narrow set/reset net is routed
not_a_claim: dynamic PRBS capture under generated clocks
